versions.changelog: Fix: correct skill name and metadata (was published as test)

Initial release of the Startup Financial Model skill.

- Build complete, investor-ready 3-statement models (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) for startups.
- Includes revenue forecasting, burn rate and runway calculator, and scenario modeling (base/bull/bear).
- Supports SaaS/subscription with cohort metrics and unit economics (LTV, CAC, NRR, payback).
- Exports structured data for Excel/Google Sheets.
- Not for public company DCF/comps, tax, bookkeeping, or real-time accounting data pulls.
Minor improvements to scenario modeling and SaaS metrics documentation
Initial release: 3-statement model builder with burn/runway calculator, scenario modeling, SaaS unit economics, and investor-ready export
